observations.measurement_context: (4) Pin Puncture Strength (mN/20 μm) The maximum load was measured, when a microporous membrane having a thickness T 1 was pricked with a needle of 1 mm in diameter with a spherical end surface (radius R of curvature: 0.5 mm) at a speed of 2 mm/second. The measured maximum load L 1 was converted to the maximum load L 2 at a thickness of 20 μm by the formula of L 2 =(L 1 ×20)/T 1 , which was regarded as pin puncture strength.
